# Verify the submitted answer: "The color of Greg is not specified in the given information."
# Method: enumerate every color assignment for each entity over the palette of
# colors appearing in the context plus one unlisted color, keep the assignments
# that satisfy all stated facts, and check whether Greg's color is the same in
# every surviving model (entailed) or varies (not entailed).

FACTS = [
    ("is_a", "Lily", "lion"),
    ("color", "Lily", "yellow"),
    ("is_a", "Julius", "lion"),
    ("color", "Julius", "gray"),
    ("is_a", "Brian", "swan"),
    ("color", "Brian", "green"),
    ("is_a", "Bernhard", "rhino"),
    ("color", "Bernhard", "yellow"),
    ("is_a", "Greg", "swan"),
]

QUERY_ENTITY = "Greg"
SUBMITTED_CLAIM = "not specified"

entities = sorted({s for (_, s, _) in FACTS})
stated_colors = {e: set() for e in entities}
for p, s, o in FACTS:
    if p == "color":
        stated_colors[s].add(o)

# Palette: every color mentioned in the context, plus one color not mentioned,
# so that "any color at all" is tested, not only the listed ones.
palette = sorted({o for (p, _, o) in FACTS if p == "color"})
UNLISTED = "__unlisted_color__"
candidates = palette + [UNLISTED]

print("Entities:", entities)
print("Stated colors:", {e: sorted(c) for e, c in stated_colors.items()})
print("Candidate colors for an unspecified entity:", candidates)

def model_satisfies(model):
    # Each entity has exactly one color, and every stated color fact holds.
    for e in entities:
        if e not in model or len(model[e]) != 1:
            return False
        if not stated_colors[e] <= model[e]:
            return False
    return True

# Enumerate all models: Greg's color ranges over candidates; others are fixed
# by the stated facts (they already have stated colors, so each has one choice).
consistent_greg_colors = []
for c in candidates:
    model = {e: set(stated_colors[e]) for e in entities}
    model[QUERY_ENTITY] = {c}
    if model_satisfies(model):
        consistent_greg_colors.append(c)

print("Greg's color across consistent models:", consistent_greg_colors)
print("Number of consistent models for Greg:", len(consistent_greg_colors))

# Check whether Greg's color is entailed (same in all consistent models).
greg_entailed = (len(set(consistent_greg_colors)) == 1)

# Check that the facts do not bind Greg's color indirectly (no color facts
# attached to any species or other entity that would transfer to Greg).
greg_has_direct_color = len(stated_colors[QUERY_ENTITY]) > 0

if greg_entailed:
    derived = consistent_greg_colors[0]
    print("Entailed color of Greg:", derived)
else:
    print("Entailed color of Greg: none (more than one color remains possible)")

print("Greg has a directly stated color:", greg_has_direct_color)

# Submitted answer says the color is not specified/determined.
claim_matches = (not greg_entailed) and (not greg_has_direct_color)
print("Submitted claim:", SUBMITTED_CLAIM)
print("Claim consistent with exhaustive enumeration:", claim_matches)

if claim_matches:
    print("CHECK PASS")
elif greg_entailed:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
else:
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
